method: Fresh primary-source checks against the existing November 5-6 research. The source facts were largely already archived. New work is the current-owned-case stress calculation and the explicit historical-to-forecast exhibit.

sources.locator: MD&A Intel Foundry, printed page 35; Note 2
sources.boundary: Period charges include multiple mechanisms and must not all be called noncash, nonrecurring or pure reserve releases. The derived325M ex-benefit decline is not normalized earnings.

Substantially all consolidated depreciation resides in Foundry overhead absorbed into inventory. Segment revenue includes internal transfer prices; consolidated profit remains the controlling measure.

verified_facts: Management reports Intel 3 wafer costs 15% below Q1 and Intel 18A costs 40% below Q1.
Management cites yield, cycle-time and utilization improvements.
New Mexico and Malaysia packaging capacity targets 2027 customer ramps.
An advanced organic substrate shortage constrains server output.
2027 gross capex is expected to rise strongly; equipment purchase orders rose nearly 40% sequentially.
Q4 client wafer-start reductions pressure fixed-cost absorption.
sources.boundary: Cost reductions already enter actual results. Different volume and cost periods cannot be multiplied into a net profit claim. Supplier purchase orders are not customer revenue commitments.

verified_facts: Management added advanced-packaging backlog and said Malaysia expansion supports committed demand expected to begin converting to revenue in 2027.
sources.boundary: No named customer dollar minimum, paid-package quantity, unit fee, cancellation protection or realized margin is disclosed.

verified_facts: The CEO describes yield-improvement work with an unnamed US IDM partner and substrate suppliers.
Customer engineering resources and a production timetable corroborate implementation work.
sources.boundary: The CEO does not name Intel in the cited answer. Analyst attribution is not customer confirmation. Accelerator chip sales are not Intel packaging fees.

search_outcome: No newly verified named packaging contract with a quantity, fee or purchase minimum supporting $7B of 2030 sales was found. Recent Intel packaging and PDK releases describe technical capability and engagements, without validating the forecast fee amounts.

recommended_exhibit.heading: Factory learning is visible; the profit hurdle remains substantial
recommended_exhibit.observed: Q1/Q2/Q3 Foundry EBIT: -$2.437B/-$2.089B/-$1.853B. Cost learning is demonstrated, while lower period charges contribute to reported improvement.
recommended_exhibit.required: The 2027 annual Foundry EBIT forecast of -$4B requires an average quarterly loss of $1B, 46.0% below the Q3 quarterly loss. The 2030 annual forecast is +$2.5B.
recommended_exhibit.stress: Breakeven only through maturity retains a $75.32 December 2030 target but reduces December 2026 value to $51.31 at 10.625%. At 11.555%, values are $44.32/$67.10.
recommended_exhibit.limits: These are forecast requirements, not independent delivery proof. Do not add historical charge benefits or cost savings again.
